headline: PASS: 7 of 7 checks pass at desktop and phone widths.
target: local server (python3 -m http.server) on this branch

checks.check: jeremy.v2 opens to its title screen and starts a game, with nothing loaded from the internet
notes: desktop: clicked Play and the first card, and the farm ran; no requests outside the site; no sideways scrolling
phone: tapped Play and the first card, and the farm ran; no requests outside the site; no sideways scrolling

checks.check: every button meets the phone bar: Speed, Sound and Pause are 48 x 48, 8 px apart and from the edge, and the menu buttons are 48 px tall
